$description: WeMeet cross-client component sizing contract. Values describe semantic visual sizes; platforms may add larger interaction targets without changing the visible control.

controlHeight.$description: Visible control heights. Compact is the default for dense Web forms; large is also the minimum Android interaction target.

icon.$description: Glyph sizes for controls and navigation.

iconButton.$description: Dense Web icon-button boxes. Android adds a 48dp semantic touch target around compact glyphs.

selectionControl.$description: Visible checkbox and radio indicators; interaction targets may be larger.
